content: I have optimized the Partial Prerendering (PPR) shell by
moving the data fetching logic out of the root `Page` component and into a nested async `DashboardContent` component.
By wrapping `DashboardContent` in a `<Suspense>` boundary with the existing `Loading` component as a fallback, Next.js

can now statically pre-render the shell of the page (e.g., the `

Dashboard

` title) while
dynamically streaming the dashboard data and widgets in the background.
